description: Press the button (green LED off), then grip the blue block at the right of the table. The drawer starts closed (an open drawer ruins the button). The grip is the last step, so no switch has to detect it; the blue block lies at a fixed spot, the other blocks are random. Random scenes: the joints the task doesn't fix are random at each reset, the blocks lie somewhere on the table, the conditions are rendered in 4 random scenes. Long runs, see dynaguide_scripts/run_long_runs_1.bat and run_long_runs_2.bat. Make it with dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py
